name: Pearl Bunny Pastoral Editorial
image_vibe: whimsical pearl pastoral, polished coquette editorial

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic garden editorial with pearl accessories, rabbits, and a playful fashion silhouette.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional blonde woman with voluminous waves, pearl jewelry, and a blue-and-white plaid puff dress with secure coverage, opaque pale-blue tights, and polished shoes; she stands upright with a slight forward lean while holding loose decorative pearl leads attached to rabbit harnesses, with animal welfare and comfort prioritized.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level 35mm garden portrait, manicured hedges, mature trees, stone lion, tiered fountain, golden-hour light, green-blue-white-gold palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm golden-hour sunlight, natural grass and hair texture, gentle background roll-off, whimsical high-fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: RAW photorealism, 8K detail, realistic rabbits, fabric, pearls, water spray, and hands, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic garden fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional blonde woman in a secure blue-and-white plaid puff dress with opaque tights, pearl choker and earrings, standing with a slight forward lean while holding loose decorative pearl leads attached to comfortable rabbit harnesses, manicured formal garden, lion statue, tiered fountain, golden hour, 35mm lens, realistic fabric and animal detail, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sheer stockings, sexualized bent-over pose, animal distress, tight restraint, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: pearl bunny garden reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the plaid dress, pearls, garden, fountain, rabbits, and warm editorial palette; keep identity and animal styling replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the pastoral concept while using opaque coverage, upright nonsexual pose, loose leads, and humane animal handling.

policy_review.changes: Removed public-figure resemblance, added opaque coverage, replaced bent-over silhouette with an upright slight lean, and specified humane loose rabbit handling.
